issues.description: The problem statement requires Course.getAverageRating() to return a Double, and the template declares getAverageRating() -> Double, but the solution implements getAverageRating() -> Float. This inconsistency between the solution and the specification/template can confuse students reviewing the reference solution or cause type-related surprises when comparing their implementations to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution implementation of getAverageRating() to return Double to match the problem statement and template. For example, change the signature to func getAverageRating() -> Double and compute the average using Double conversions (e.g. Double(starSum) / Double(totalRatings)).
